responsibility: Declares the SARIF-specific public interface of GCC’s diagnostics subsystem. It exposes the SARIF version enum, sink/file/stream initialization helpers for attaching SARIF output to a diagnostic_context, the RAII file-opening helper used by SARIF emitters, and the small SARIF JSON object wrapper types and logical-location factory used by the implementation to build standards-compliant SARIF object graphs from GCC diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: This header is the declaration side of the SARIF formatter pair: unlike gcc/diagnostic-format-sarif.cc, which builds and emits SARIF runs/results, it only exposes the SARIF-facing types, version enum, initialization/opening helpers, and lightweight JSON wrapper declarations used by clients and the implementation.
